from mem_mcp.mcp.tool_descriptions import TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS

tools = [
    'mindmap_workflow_create',
    'mindmap_workflow_get',
    'mindmap_workflow_activate',
    'mindmap_workflow_propose_move',
    'mindmap_workflow_signoff',
    'mindmap_workflow_cancel_move',
    'mindmap_workflow_remap',
    'mindmap_workflow_pending_signoffs',
    'mindmap_work_list',
    'mindmap_work_get',
    'mindmap_work_history',
]

print("Tool Description Word Counts:")
print("-" * 50)
for tool in tools:
    desc = TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS[tool]
    word_count = len(desc.split())
    status = "✓" if 80 <= word_count <= 250 else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {tool}: {word_count} words")

print("-" * 50)
all_in_range = all(80 <= len(TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS[t].split()) <= 250 for t in tools)
print(f"All in range (80-250): {all_in_range}")
EOF
